decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - No flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the southern sidewall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - Reason for Approval

The proposed single storey side extension, by means of its size, positioning, design and appearance, has due respect for the dwelling's original design and the character of the immediate locality and would not harm the living conditions of adjoining residents and is therefore in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development) and H.6.4 (Housing Extensions) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003 and complies with the Council's Residential Extensions Guidelines.
description: Erection of single storey side extension to dwelling house.
